name: hisd-brand-designer
description: Design, brand, and theme any HISD media with the HISD design system: tokens (CSS custom properties, DTCG JSON, Sass, Power BI theme), 24 components including Skeleton loading states and an icon-based Theme Toggle (CSS + React + Web Components), platform kits, Material icons, and the brand assets — in light and dark, accessibly.

build-tokens.description: Generate every token artifact from the brand source; exits non-zero if any semantic pairing regresses below WCAG 2.2 AA.

build-components.description: Bundle the per-component CSS into components.css and regenerate the gallery.

lint-components.description: Gate: every component paints color only through tokens and keeps a visible focus ring.

validate-tokens.description: DTCG conformance check for the generated token file.

brand-scan.description: The 'teal test': scan any path for off-brand color, CDN fonts, non-brand typefaces, or missing focus rings.

scaffold.description: Scaffold an on-brand starter for a chosen medium (web-page, email, report, deck, powerbi).

make-asset-manifest.description: Refresh brand-assets.json from the skill's vendored logos and fonts.

pull-material-icons.description: Vendor filled Material Symbols icons (Rounded, FILL=1, weight 500) from github.com/google/material-design-icons.

build-palette-matrix.description: Generate the expanded 4%/10% tint/tone/shade palette reference (hex/RGB/CMYK, Pantone on anchors, names on the main colors).

svg-minify.description: Conservative, dependency-free SVG optimizer (strips non-rendered metadata; --precision -1 never rounds geometry).

generate-app-icons.description: Render a favicon + app-icon set from the brand skyline mark.

catalog-assets.description: Guarded one-time brand-asset extraction / re-vendor the skill assets from the repo catalog.

project-adapters.description: Project the canonical skill into thin native-lane pointer adapters (.claude/skills, .agents/skills); --check verifies drift.

_notes: Tool-bearing skill. The canonical body + scripts + assets live once under .skills/design/hisd-brand-designer/; the NATIVE lanes (Claude Code, Codex) consume GENERATED THIN POINTER adapters under .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ that reference the canonical SKILL.md and never copy it (run scripts/project_adapters.py). The assistant zip lanes (Claude.ai/OpenAI dev-API) are NOT targeted: at 155MB / 1310 files the skill far exceeds their 50MB / 500-file budget, and that limit binds only a full-copy zip, not a thin adapter.
